title: CARE: Contrastive-Anchored Residual Encoding with Listwise Reconstruction for Retrieval-Oriented Semantic IDs
abstract: arXiv:2611.20721v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative retrieval replaces nearest-neighbor search with the generation of a document's semantic ID (SID), so the SID tokenizer bounds what the retriever can recall. Common SID constructions (residual k-means, RQ-VAE, finite scalar quantization, capacity balancing) optimize criteria defined on document embeddings alone and do not control whether a query can still find its relevant documents after quantization. We propose two retrieval-oriented SID tokenizers. CARE-SID (Contrastive-Anchored Residual Encoding for Semantic IDs) quantizes in a retrieval-aligned space: a zero-initialized residual alignment network is trained with a query-document contrastive loss before quantization, an anchor loss and a reconstruction target fixed to the original embedding prevent drift and collapse, and reference-vector rating residual quantization assigns the codes. translated_title: CARE：面向检索语义ID的对比锚定残差编码与列表式重建
translated_abstract: 生成式检索通过生成文档的语义ID（SID）来取代最近邻搜索，因此SID分词器决定了检索器能够召回的上限。常见的SID构建方法（残差k-means、RQ-VAE、有限标量量化、容量平衡）仅优化基于文档嵌入定义的准则，而无法控制查询在量化之后是否仍能找到其相关文档。我们提出了两种面向检索的SID分词器。CARE-SID（对比锚定残差语义ID编码）在检索对齐的空间中进行量化：在量化之前，使用查询-文档对比损失训练一个零初始化的残差对齐网络；锚定损失和固定于原始嵌入的重建目标可防止漂移和坍缩；并通过参考向量评级残差量化来分配编码。CARE-LR（带列表式重建的CARE）随后为每个训练查询蒸馏……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 论文提出CARE-SID与CARE-LR两种面向检索的语义ID分词器，通过查询-文档对比对齐、锚定残差量化和列表式重建，确保量化后的语义ID仍能支持查询对相关文档的有效召回。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes CARE-SID and CARE-LR, two retrieval-oriented semantic ID tokenizers that combine query-document contrastive alignment, anchored residual quantization, and listwise reconstruction to preserve retrieval effectiveness after quantization.
